fields.label: What must the proposed specification change?

risks.mitigation: Run it exactly once as specified and publish the real command, exit status, counts, and output; classify inability to run as a known issue and never synthesize results.
risks.description: The full observation test command may depend on local PostgreSQL or other runtime configuration and can legitimately fail or skip tests in this isolated environment.

risks.mitigation: Before inspection or tests, detach at the specified branch ref and record git rev-parse HEAD as build_result.head_sha; the assessor must use that same SHA in every file-range citation.
risks.description: The worktree begins at the PR base, so evidence could accidentally be collected from b442f99c rather than the audited c7e326b7 head.

risks.mitigation: Keep exactly the requested audit cohort and T1/T2; treat unrelated files only as supporting evidence when they directly prove ordered delivery, test behavior, or transaction semantics.
risks.description: PR #791 is much broader than the two-task audit, making it easy for plan or assessment scope to drift into unrelated changes.

body.summary: The audit is implementable without operator clarification. The specified head c7e326b7d1c7b03e8d051a079967d496b07e541f is locally available and descends from the stated PR base b442f99ccdd68699a346ee55dd9fbe27bc3335d0. Repository evidence supports T1 default-off launch configuration and ordered delivery, plus T2 lock-first exact-claim fencing and atomic completion/observation. The builder and assessor can remain read-only apart from the explicitly required detached checkout, dependency materialization if needed, test execution, and artifact publication.

findings.description: T1 has a named domain model and deterministic default: RunConfig includes grading_enabled, parseRunConfig maps an omitted choice to false, rejects non-booleans, and preserves worker-session selection (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:4-47). The launch mapper emits the committed config beside input, preserves null for a launch with no config, and refuses malformed committed data (oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:13-43).

The ordered-delivery qualification in T1 is supported beyond the two focus files: the publisher reads the immutable committed run config only for a launched event and includes it in that event delivery (oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation.ts:13-20), while the read store distinguishes none, committed, and malformed states (oakridge-dbos/src/storage/read-store.ts:467-476). Observation treats either null/no captured launch as grading off (observation/src/storage/run-capture-store.ts:16-26).

T2 exact-claim fencing is concrete and testable: the predicate requires claimed status, lease owner, claim attempt, and an unexpired database-time lease; settlement locks the execution row before evaluating the predicate and re-applies the predicate on the authoritative update (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:194-228).

T2 atomicity and worker integration are explicit: completeExecution settles the execution, closes the same provider attempt, and inserts the grade observation inside one tenant transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:267-292); settleClaim routes a valid provider answer through that operation and handles failures through fenced settlement (observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-95). Existing integration coverage checks rollback on a refused observation and successful one-for-one completion (observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:231-244), and stale/expired claims are covered separately (observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:304-357).

The verification procedure is sufficiently pinned: the branch ref resolves locally to c7e326b7d1c7b03e8d051a079967d496b07e541f, whose merge base with origin/epic/grade-pray is b442f99ccdd68699a346ee55dd9fbe27bc3335d0. The observation workspace defines test as bun test ./tests (observation/package.json:1-8), so the required bun run --filter observation test command has an unambiguous target. Actual counts and output must still come only from the builder run.

requirements.description: Produce exactly one cohort named audit with exactly two tasks, T1 and T2, scoped to the stated committed PR head.
T1 audits that grading_enabled is carried by launch config, defaults off when omitted, and survives ordered launch delivery in the named Oakridge files.
T2 audits that evaluation settlement is fenced to the exact current claim and completion appends its observation in the same transaction in the named Observation files.

The builder detaches at origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2, performs no source/commit/remote/database/deployment mutations, runs the observation test command once, reports actual output, and publishes the existing PR #791 rather than creating or changing a PR.
The assessor examines the same head without changes, reports at least one file-range finding per task, cites test/output evidence separately, and reports the builder test run as test_evidence.
